policy: 45 curated narrative priorities, not official ranked strongest list.
Lady of Pain is not a deity.
Mystra incarnation and the Weave must be dated.
Alignment is campaign moral role, not a permanent absolute alignment claim.
Dialogue is original and requires source/personality review before a direct divine encounter.
No rewards or state changes from reading dialogue.

lines.speaker: Eilistraee
lines.text: You stand at a threshold, Alice Z'ress. Freedom shapes what may follow, but your choices remain your own.

lines.speaker: Eilistraee
lines.text: Do not mistake a sign for an answer. Look at what is happening here, and ask who benefits if you act.

lines.speaker: Eilistraee
lines.text: You spared someone when another path was easier. What will you do with their trust?

lines.speaker: Eilistraee
lines.text: Disagreement is not betrayal. Explain the principle you intend to defend.

lines.speaker: Eilistraee
lines.text: You have returned. The place has changed, and so have you. Speak of what happened since our last encounter.

lines.speaker: Eilistraee
lines.text: A blessing does not replace the work you must still do.

lines.speaker: Eilistraee
lines.text: You cannot undo every harm. You can decide how to answer for this one.

lines.speaker: Eilistraee
lines.text: The name you know may not belong to this age. First establish which era and manifestation you have reached.
